How Do Professionals Clean Your Tile and Grout?

November 20, 2020

Besides your carpets and area rugs, your tiles and grouts are the most challenging areas to clean inside your home or office. Seeing your tile walls, backsplash, and floors all dingy and dark, ruins the curb appeal of your place.

If you cannot do a DIY solution for this, then call for a tile grout cleaning servicenear you.

Meanwhile, if you are having a difficult time restoring the clean and white looks of your grouts, then you came to the right place. In this read, we are sharing the essential steps and tips done by professionals for their tile cleaning service.

Let’s roll.

What factors contribute to grout stains

Whether it’s the grout in your bathroom or kitchen tiles, the elements causing its dingy and dark looks are the stains and dirt washed out from your tiles. The grout lines in between your tiles are located at a lower level, so all washed dirt goes there and gets stuck.

Also, the porous nature of grout strongly contributes to the great effort you need to exert in cleaning it. Therefore, your best solution for this dilemma will be hiring your local grout cleaning serviceprovider.

Shiny Carpet Cleaningwill be your best cleaning partner for these cumbersome cleaning chores in your homes and offices.

Benefits of A Clean Tile and Grout

Leaving your tiles and grout dirty and black can be a breeding ground of molds, mildews, and bacteria, which can cause health illnesses to your family and employees. With that, the main benefit of regular and professional grout steam cleaningwill be a healthier place for your loved ones and workers.

We use green cleaning products and pressurized hot water for our steam cleaning process. In that way, that stubborn dirt and stains are softened and easily washed out from your tiles and grouts.

Besides that, you are restoring the elegance and beauty of your kitchen, living area, and bathroom when your tiles and grout are well-maintained and cleaned. Likewise, it prolongs the sturdy condition of your grouts and ceramic tiles.

Steps For Tile Cleaning

Here are some of the practical steps you can adapt for your DIY ceramic or porcelain tile cleaningprocess.

  1. Sweeping or vacuuming all soils and loose dirt in your tiles
  2. Apply a neutral or appropriate tile cleaning solution and then mop or scrub your tiles
  3. Applying steam cleaning process to your tiles
  4. Letting your tiles air dry or assisted with an electric fan

When cleaning your tiles, make sure to avoid strong bleaching agents or acidic solutions, for it can discolor and dull your floor tiles. Fortunately, our personnel know the appropriate cleaning solution to apply for cleaning various tiles.

Steps For Grout Cleaning

Now, let’s proceed with the daunting task of cleansing your porous grouts. Here are some basic steps you can do at home or in your office.

  1. Scrub or mop the surface grime and dirt on your grouts. Use a non-abrasive cloth and hot water for this process.
  2. Create a homemade grout cleaning solution using baking soda, hydrogen peroxide, and dishwashing soap solution.
  3. Apply a substantial amount of your homemade cleaning solution to your dingy grouts. Let it sit for 5 to 10 minutes.
  4. You can use your old toothbrush for scrubbing those grout lines. Apply sufficient pressure when brushing it.
  5. Rinse with water and then wipe clean with a towel.
